_comment: #72 Special rooms and events. From first_depth each floor gets count[0]-count[1] events (count_weights per count), a seeded pick by weight among the events whose min_depth is reached, never two of a kind. Placement (DungeonGenerator._place_events): events stand in normal rooms only (never the start, boss, merchant or forge chamber), the vault is a sealed leaf of its own. All times in seconds. Loot sources are in balance.json loot.event_sources and gold.
